nonClaimNotice: The prepared package covered three Access Only datasets, but the form actually submitted on 2026-08-21 covered only the FOM Cutblocks catalogue URL. Submission and the later clarification reply are not permission, not a licence, not a fee agreement, and not an artifact, acquisition, archive, transformation, ingestion, release, or production authorization. VRI and TAP remain unsubmitted. The TAP Current View is kept distinct from the authoritative implemented-deferral layer, which has not been identified.

sourceEvidence.subject: RE: Permission and authoritative-export request — VRI 2025, FOM Cutblocks, and TAP deferral layer
sourceEvidence.proceduralFinding: The copyright office said all three datasets may be included in one Copyright Permission Request Form and that the form should include the requested details at its foot. The earlier message in the same thread requires exact catalogue names and URLs, intended use, audience and formats/channels; it says custodians will be consulted, a licensing vehicle will be determined if permission can be granted, and a permission/licence fee will apply.

submissionOutcome.submissionEvidence: A copyright-office reply quoted the new form submission and its FOM catalogue URL. Personal contact fields and mailbox identifiers are intentionally not retained.
submissionOutcome.clarificationFinding: The copyright officer noted that FOM is view-only rather than downloadable and asked how it would be used on the website.
